description: Poll an async job started by omnarai_query or omnarai_trace. Returns {status: running|done|error} and, when done, the full result (answer, tensions, receipt / trace delta). Poll every ~5 seconds; jobs typically finish in 30–60s.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by omnarai_query or omnarai_trace.

name: omnarai_job
